overrides.note: Templar hammer temp-pet ability (Inquisitors do NOT get the hammer) - the pet swings log under the owner's own name, and the name is absent from census spell lists, so the map called it an item proc.
Proc from the Tunare's Wrath bow. The map knows a Fury/Warden spell of the same name, so on non-druids it was mislabelled a granted raid buff.
Heroic Opportunity finisher - part of the character's own play, not an item proc (absent from census, so the map defaulted to item).
Freeblood racial proc - intrinsic to the character, not an item proc (absent from census, so the map defaulted to item).
